photos.desc: Rye field on Bistra Mountain, Macedonia

Cereal rye (Secale cereale), Grass family (Poaceae), covering sloped of the Red Butte near Salt Lake City, Utah. By the end of June, the dry thicket of the rye significantly increases the fire danger.
